- To international Ph.D. applicants: we only consider candidates who have published at least one first-author paper in CVPR/ICCV/ECCV/TPAMI. This is also the lowest requirement for Chinese candidates.

Public Announcement:
From 2021/8/20, any student or faculty member from our group is forbidden to collaborate with authors who didn’t make their paper code publicly available! Students are forbidden from collaborating without formal permission. Moreover, students in our group MUST follow our DOCX initiative.
